desc: Implement KMP automaton: prefix function pi and transition table next_state[s][c] for s in 0..m, c in 0..25, aliasing state m to its border.
Backward bitset DP over KMP states with per-position constraints: 'T' requires state m, 'F' forbids state m; return "" if bit 0 of dp[0] unset.
Forward greedy reconstruction choosing smallest feasible char via dp[p+1].
Verified examples: "TFTF"/"ab" -> "ababa"; "TFTF"/"abc" -> ""; "F"/"d" -> "a"; plus overlapping T/F and repeated-pattern edge cases.
